name: Life Underwriter
description: Owns risk selection and quote-to-bind decisions within the Underwriting value stream, revising and re-issuing quotes to brokers and binding policies within appetite guidelines. Screens cases against reinsurance treaty retentions, prepares reinsurance bordereaux, applies experience and schedule rating adjustments, and supports underwriting quality assurance and appetite exception tracking through the underwriting workstation and policy administration system.

name: Litigation Counsel
description: Leads litigation strategy and case assessment within Legal & Corporate Governance, developing disputes positions and documenting structured settlements in claim files. Supports board meeting planning and evaluation, secretarial and regulatory filings, and legal entity administration, while advising on political contributions compliance, contract financial obligations, and vendor data-processing governance including validation of vendor privacy and security controls.

name: Litigation Manager
description: Oversees dispute and litigation matters within Legal & Corporate Governance, issuing arbitration demands, appointing party arbitrators, and negotiating with regulators to resolve objections. Manages regulatory filing and secretarial obligations, board meeting planning, and legal entity administration, coordinates e-discovery readiness with IT, and administers political contributions compliance and contract financial obligations using the GRC platform.

name: MDM Specialist
description: Administers master and reference data management across the Data & AI value stream, validating reference data against authoritative sources and publishing it to the enterprise store. Operates the MDM platform, executes matching and survivorship rules, defines trust scoring criteria, certifies qualifying data sets, and reports MDM availability and SLA metrics to governance.

name: ML Engineer
description: Owns machine-learning model delivery within the Data & AI value stream, translating business problems into prediction targets and framing AI use cases. Builds and trains models, validates them on hold-out test sets, maintains the model registry and CI/CD pipeline, and conducts deployment readiness reviews with performance KPIs and governance pre-approval before release.

name: MLOps Engineer
description: Operates model deployment and lifecycle infrastructure for the Data & AI value stream, authoring automated training pipelines as code and provisioning autoscaling model-serving endpoints. Maintains the model registry and CI/CD pipeline, captures lineage to data and feature versions, implements automated rollback on failed health checks, and approves retrained challengers for production under model risk governance.

name: Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager
description: Leads market conduct examination support and compliance testing within Risk, Compliance & Audit, building corrective-action plans and tracking remediation to closure. Manages regulatory change and conduct filings, validates control deficiency closure evidence, re-tests remediated controls, and monitors key risk indicators, reconciling KRI anomalies with data owners through the GRC platform.

name: Market Research Analyst
description: Performs market opportunity definition and product concept screening for the Product & Delivery value stream, designing voice-of-customer research and synthesizing findings into validated needs. Supports product roadmap planning and business cases by assessing concept feasibility, regulatory and competitive constraints, and capability gaps, and facilitates stakeholder alignment on strategy and portfolio themes.

name: Marketing Compliance Analyst
description: Performs advertising compliance review across Sales, Distribution & Marketing, checking copy against disclosure requirements and verifying producer licensing before ads publish. Maintains marketing governance standards and campaign approval workflows, applies consent controls to audience segments, validates marketing data quality, and supports sales conduct surveillance and marketing performance reporting through the GRC platform and evidence repository.

name: Marketing Manager
description: Leads agency and broker relationship governance within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, shaping distribution operating-model design and channel strategy from market data by line and geography. Oversees delegated authority arrangements, producer pipeline support and training, and retention and cross-sell analytics, obtaining compliance sign-off on partner materials and tracking corrective actions to completion.

name: Marketing Specialist
description: Coordinates producer and channel operations across Sales, Distribution & Marketing, providing quote-to-bind producer support and processing inbound direct-to-consumer applications. Supports delegated authority oversight, ongoing producer compliance monitoring, and producer termination governance, and builds propensity models and digital channel performance dashboards using the CRM and enterprise data warehouse.

name: Medical / Nurse Case Manager
description: Coordinates ongoing medical claim management within the Claims value stream, ordering IMEs or FCEs when evidence is insufficient and documenting liability decisions and structured settlements in claim files. Manages claims workflow routing and misrouted-claim rebalancing, denial logging and appeal follow-up, and maintains the vendor network directory on the claims management platform.

name: Medical Claims Reviewer
description: Performs medical claim reviews within the Claims value stream, evaluating liability, documenting decisions, and notifying file owners. Handles denial management by logging denials and setting appeal follow-ups, monitors routing exceptions and rebalances misrouted claims, and supports structured settlement placement and network management in the claims management platform.
